function usefulOfficialLeads(items,date){

  let n=0;for(const k of ['活动预告','花展','演出','音乐','展览','看新展','公园','体验','打卡','开放','市集','艺术','活动','夜游'])if((x.title||'').includes(k))n+=2;
  n+=Math.max(0,20-Math.max(0,safeDateDays(nowShanghai(),x.publishedAt||nowShanghai())))*.1;
  return n;
 };
 const good=(items||[]).filter(x=>x&&x.title&&x.url&&x.publishedAt
  &&x.publishedAt>=since&&x.publishedAt<=nowShanghai()
  &&/^https:\/\/whlyj\.sh\.gov\.cn\//.test(x.url)
  &&EVENT_LEAD_INCLUDE.test(x.title)&&!EVENT_LEAD_EXCLUDE.test(x.title));
 good.sort((a,b)=>score(b)-score(a)||b.publishedAt.localeCompare(a.publishedAt)||a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
 const unique=[],seen=new Set();
 for(const x of good){const key=x.title.replace(/[\s“”‘’.,，。！!？?：:·\-—]/g,'').slice(0,13);if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);unique.push(x)}
 return unique;
}

/* 民俗历法：2000-01-01 戊午日；1984 立春后甲子年。
   使用节气划分年月，北京时间划分时辰，不计算真太阳时。 */
function birthPillars(date,time){
 if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date||''))return null;
 const p=parseISO(date),utc=Date.UTC(p.y,p.m-1,p.d);
 if(!Number.isFinite(utc)||new Date(utc).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==date||p.y<1900||p.y>2100)return null;
 const cyc=n=>((n%60)+60)%60;
 const lichun=Object.entries(getTerms(p.y)).find(x=>x[1]==='立春');
 const year=lichun&&date<lichun[0]?p.y-1:p.y;
 const yi=cyc(year-1984),ms=monthBranchFor(date);
 const mstem=(yi%10%5*2+2+(ms-2+12)%12)%10;
 const di=cyc(54+Math.round((utc-Date.UTC(2000,0,1))/86400000));
 const o={year:heavenly[yi%10]+earthly[yi%12],month:heavenly[mstem]+earthly[ms],day:heavenly[di%10]+earthly[di%12],dayStem:di%10,dayIndex:di,hour:'',hourBranch:null};
 if(/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(time||'')){
  const hr=Number(time.slice(0,2)),hb=Math.floor(((hr+1)%24)/2);
  o.hour=heavenly[(di%10%5*2+hb)%10]+earthly[hb];o.hourBranch=hb;
 }
 return o;
}

 '小寒':['蜡梅','寒枝初香',13], '大寒':['红梅','凌寒独放',12],
 '立春':['迎春花','迎春花醒',0], '雨水':['玉兰','春雨润玉',1],
 '惊蛰':['桃花','惊雷醒桃',2], '春分':['樱花','春色平分',3],
 '清明':['海棠','雨润海棠',4], '谷雨':['牡丹','谷雨花时',5],
 '立夏':['月季','花影初夏',14], '小满':['石榴花','小满花红',11],
 '芒种':['栀子花','栀香初浓',19], '夏至':['荷花','荷风清夏',17],
 '小暑':['紫薇','夏色渐浓',17], '大暑':['睡莲','水上花影',18],
 '立秋':['桂花','金风送桂',6], '处暑':['紫薇','夏末仍芳',7],
 '白露':['木槿','露凝花影',8], '秋分':['菊花','秋光平分',9],
 '寒露':['柿子花果','露重秋深',20], '霜降':['红枫','霜染层林',21],
 '立冬':['茶梅','初冬花信',12], '小雪':['山茶','微雪含芳',11],
 '大雪':['雪中梅','雪意初深',13], '冬至':['蜡梅','岁暮温香',12]
};
function renderSolarArtwork(term){
 const flower=SOLAR_FLOWERS_24[term]||SOLAR_FLOWERS_24['寒露'];
 const i=flower[2],col=i%6,row=Math.floor(i/6);
 const root=document.documentElement;
 root.style.setProperty('--term-flower-position',col*20+'% '+row*(100/3)+'%');
 root.dataset.solarFlower=flower[0];
 const title=document.getElementById('solarFlowerName');
 if(title)title.textContent=term+' · '+flower[0]+'｜'+flower[1];
}
const SOLAR_TERM_THEMES=window.ZHISHI_DESIGN_SYSTEM?.themes||{};
const THEME_STORAGE_KEY='zhishi-solar-theme-mode-v1';
const TERM_FLORAL_ART={
 '立春':['01','桃花'],'雨水':['02','玉兰'],'惊蛰':['03','迎春花'],'春分':['04','樱花'],
 '清明':['05','海棠'],'谷雨':['06','紫藤'],'立夏':['07','月季'],'小满':['08','麦穗'],
 '芒种':['09','荷花'],'夏至':['10','莲花'],'小暑':['11','凌霄'],'大暑':['12','向日葵'],
 '立秋':['13','桂花'],'处暑':['14','紫薇'],'白露':['15','芦苇'],'秋分':['16','银杏'],
 '寒露':['17','菊花'],'霜降':['18','红枫'],'立冬':['19','山茶花'],'小雪':['20','红梅'],
 '大雪':['21','红梅'],'冬至':['22','水仙'],'小寒':['23','松柏'],'大寒':['24','红梅']
};
let currentSolarThemeName='';
function termForShanghaiDay(date){
 const y=Number(date.slice(0,4));
 let current='冬至';
 for(const [day,name] of Object.entries({...getTerms(y-1),...getTerms(y)}).sort((a,b)=>a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))){
   if(day>date)break;
   if(SOLAR_TERM_THEMES[name])current=name;
 }
 return current;
}
function readThemeMode(){
 try{const mode=localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY)||'auto';return mode==='auto'||mode==='neutral'||SOLAR_TERM_THEMES[mode]?mode:'auto'}catch(e){return 'auto'}
}
function applySeasonTheme(){
 const mode=readThemeMode();
 const term=termForShanghaiDay(nowShanghai());
 const neutral={bg:'#F7F8F7',primary:'#728A80',surface:'#EDF2EE',accent:'#B8C7B7'};
 const name=mode==='auto'?term:mode;
 const colors=mode==='neutral'?neutral:(SOLAR_TERM_THEMES[name]||SOLAR_TERM_THEMES[term]||neutral);
 const root=document.documentElement;
 const deep='color-mix(in srgb,'+colors.primary+' 68%,#202F30)';
 for(const [key,value] of Object.entries({'--season-bg':colors.bg,'--season-primary':colors.primary,'--season-surface':colors.surface,'--season-accent':colors.accent,'--season-deep':deep,'--season-border':'color-mix(in srgb,'+colors.accent+' 29%,#e4e9e8)'}))root.style.setProperty(key,value);
 root.dataset.solarTheme=name;
 const termArt=TERM_FLORAL_ART[SOLAR_TERM_THEMES[name]?name:term]||TERM_FLORAL_ART[term];
 if(termArt){root.style.setProperty('--term-art',`url("/data/term-art/${termArt[0]}.webp")`);}
 const flowerInfo=document.getElementById('solarFlowerName');
 if(flowerInfo&&termArt)flowerInfo.textContent=(SOLAR_TERM_THEMES[name]?name:term)+' · '+termArt[1]+'水彩';
 const select=document.getElementById('seasonThemeMode');
 if(select&&select.value!==mode)select.value=mode;
 const status=document.getElementById('seasonStatus');
 if(status){status.textContent=mode==='auto'?term+' · 自动':mode==='neutral'?'简约模式':name+' · 固定';status.title='北京时间 · 当前节气 '+term;}
 currentSolarThemeName=name;
 renderSolarArtwork(name==='简约固定'||name==='neutral'?term:name);
}
document.getElementById('seasonThemeMode').addEventListener('change',event=>{
 try{localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY,event.target.value)}catch(e){showToast('主题偏好无法保存')}
 applySeasonTheme();
 showToast(event.target.value==='auto'?'已开启随二十四节气自动换色':'主题已切换');
});
applySeasonTheme();
refreshDailyCulture();
window.setInterval(()=>{applySeasonTheme();refreshDailyCulture()},60*1000);
window.addEventListener('focus',()=>{applySeasonTheme();refreshDailyCulture()});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!document.hidden){applySeasonTheme();refreshDailyCulture()}});

$('fortuneInfoButton').addEventListener('click',()=>{showToast('色彩参考节气与日主五行文化；数字按日期与干支取数，不具有预测能力。出生时辰未确定时请以暂定时柱为参考。')});
renderAll();loadWeather();
</script>
